question: Who was the captain of the Lucknow Super Giants in the fifteenth edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**KL Rahul**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The captain of the **Lucknow Super Giants** in the **fifteenth edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL)**, which was held in **2022**, was **KL Rahul**.
 
• The **Lucknow Super Giants (LSG)** made their debut in the **2022 IPL**, the league's fifteenth edition.
 
• The team was one of two new franchises introduced that season, alongside the Gujarat Titans.
 
• KL Rahul had a stellar individual season, scoring **616 runs** in 15 matches at an impressive average of **51.33** and a strike rate of **135.38**.
 
• This included two centuries, cementing his position as one of the top scorers in IPL 2022.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **first edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL)** cricket tournament was held in the year 2008.
 
• The IPL is a professional **Twenty20 cricket league in India, founded by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI**).
 
• The league has gained immense popularity and has become one of the most-watched cricket leagues in the world.
 
• The inaugural season of the IPL featured eight teams representing different cities in India.
 
• The league format **includes a round-robin group stage followed by playoffs and a final match to determine the champion**.
 
• The **IPL was conceptualized by Lalit Modi, who served as its first chairman and commissioner.**
 
• **Since its inception, the league has attracted top international and domestic cricket talent, making it a highly competitive and entertaining tourna**ment.
